_about: The village festivals (Festivals, scripts/festivals/festivals.gd; README.md, Festivals). One per season, all our own: names, dates, hours and looks were made up for Harvest Son. Per festival: name (HUD tag and calendar), season, day, hours ["H:MM", "H:MM") on the map where it is held, place (the cell it gathers round, [x, y]; `--festival=<id>` starts the farmer there facing up), event (data/events, plays once a year when the farmer is on the map in the hours), closes (shop ids from data/shops.json that stay shut all day), props (decorations on the map during the hours: {kind, cell, size?}; not solid, so they never block a walk; looks in FestivalProps / FestivalView), optional fireworks ["H:MM", "H:MM") (bursts over the 3D view in those hours). DESIGN: a festival day is always sunny (the weather rolled for it is replaced the evening before). Optional contest: {name, takes (the kind of entry: crop, fish, animal for eggs / milk / wool, mine for the mine's ores and stones), table (a cell of a judge_table prop; E there with an entry overhead enters it, empty-handed the judge says the `ask` line of data/dialogue/contests.json), in_season (score factor for an entry that grows in the festival's season), rivals [{who (a villager), score [lowest, highest]}] rolled once per festival and year, prizes by place [{money, item?, count?}], event (data/events, the results; flags contest_place_<n> and contest_won_<rival> are set for its lines)}. An entry scores its shipping value; one entry a year; the farmer wins ties. Optional stall: {id?, name, cell (a cell of a stall prop), stock [{item, price?}]}, or a list of them (each with its own id), a shop (id stall:<festival>, or stall:<festival>:<stall id>) that sells only in the festival's hours; its stock is set out on the stall's counter in both views, and the other stall props are only looks. Placing in a contest also gives a ribbon (data/keepsakes.json). Prize money is kept small: a first prize is about a good day's shipping. Optional game: a contest that is played instead of judged, {id (its ribbon key and `--contest=<id>`), name, kind (mochi: pounding in time with a partner who turns the dough; MochiPound), cell (a cell of a mochi_usu prop; E there with empty hands starts it), partners (villagers who turn the dough; the one the farmer is closest to takes the job, the first on a tie, and sits out as a rival), lead (seconds before the first beat), gap (seconds between rounds), rounds [{beats, beat (seconds between strikes)}], windows {great, good} (seconds either side of a beat; good under half the fastest beat), points {great, good, miss} (a miss is a press off the beat or a beat let pass; the score never drops below 0), rivals, prizes and event as for a contest}. Balance: three rounds of 8, 10 and 12 strikes, faster each time, 90 points at best; a steady player who lands most strikes as good or great gets 45-65, about where the rivals roll. Or kind fishing (a race; FishingRace): {id, name, kind, cell (a cell of a race_flag prop by the water; E there with empty hands and the rod in the tool slots starts it), lead (seconds of count-in), seconds (the race, 10 to 600; the clock holds meanwhile), rivals, prizes, event}: the farmer fishes with the real rod and bite rules (data/fish.json) and scores one point a fish landed in time; the catch goes in a creel and is let go at the end, and once-only fish do not bite in a race. Balance (Moon Night): 60 seconds at dusk bites (0.32 a check after 2.5 s) is about 5 s a fish, so a quick player lands 9-11 with the first rod, 13-14 with the best; a steady one 7-9, where Hachiro rolls 6-11 and the others 2-9.
